note: Hand-researched split of each ADHDme clinician's own published words into philosophy, lived experience and quotes. Keyed on the ADHDme clinician id. pipeline/adapters/adhdme.py prefers these over its own derivation; an id with no entry here gets the derived split.

beth-hansen.philosophy_of_care: Aims to create a space where patients feel heard, understood and taken seriously; a gentle, practical and thorough approach to ADHD assessment and care.
beth-hansen.communication_approach: Takes time to explore symptoms in the context of a person's life: work, study, relationships, parenting, sleep, emotional regulation and mental health.
beth-hansen.outside_medicine: Has worked across urban, rural and remote settings, which shaped her interest in accessible and compassionate mental health care.

quotes.text: A UQ graduate and a Fellow of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners, she brings a gentle, practical and thorough approach to ADHD assessment and care.
In her consultations, Beth aims to create a space where patients feel heard, understood and taken seriously.
She has a strong interest in how ADHD can present in women, especially when symptoms have been missed, minimised or attributed to other causes.

bill-liley.philosophy_of_care: A practical, whole-person approach to ADHD care that considers each patient's circumstances and how ADHD affects day-to-day life.
bill-liley.communication_approach: Values the access telehealth gives people who would otherwise struggle to reach ADHD care.
bill-liley.outside_medicine: Rural generalist based in regional Queensland; has worked in Aboriginal Community Controlled Health Organisations and across Queensland, New South Wales and Victoria.

quotes.text: Bill brings a practical, whole-person approach to ADHD care, taking into consideration each patient’s individual circumstances and how ADHD impacts their day-to-day life.
Based in regional Queensland, he also appreciates the accessibility that telehealth provides, particularly for people who may otherwise have difficulty accessing ADHD care.

hannah-gray.philosophy_of_care: Practical strategies and realistic next steps that fit a person's day-to-day life; welcomes people new to mental health or ADHD assessment.
hannah-gray.communication_approach: Calm, structured and collaborative; explains her thinking and plans clearly so patients understand each step.

quotes.text: In consultations, Hannah is calm, structured and collaborative.
She takes pride in explaining her thinking and plans clearly so patients understand each step of the process.
Dr Hannah Gray is a warm and approachable GP with a strong interest in mental health and adult ADHD.

jae-cho.philosophy_of_care: Evidence-based, trauma-informed care grounded in the biopsychosocial model, with a tailored plan built with the patient.
jae-cho.communication_approach: A calm manner and thoughtful explanations that make difficult topics feel manageable; works closely with GPs, psychologists and families.

quotes.text: Jae’s approach is evidence-based, trauma-informed, and grounded in the biopsychosocial model.
He takes the time to understand each patient’s background, strengths, and goals, and works collaboratively to create a tailored treatment plan.

john-ruberry.philosophy_of_care: Passionate about improving access to ADHD care and supporting patients through assessment and treatment.
john-ruberry.why_medicine: Has seen firsthand the positive difference effective ADHD treatment can make to a person's quality of life.
john-ruberry.outside_medicine: Owned and ran his own busy clinic for five years.

quotes.text: Throughout his career, he has developed a strong interest in mental health and has seen firsthand the positive difference effective ADHD treatment can make to a person’s quality of life.
He is passionate about improving access to ADHD care and supporting patients through their assessment and treatment journey.

kay-walls.philosophy_of_care: An ADHD assessment is never just a checklist: interested in the whole person, their history, relationships, patterns and strengths.
kay-walls.communication_approach: Creates space for patients to tell their story fully; culturally sensitive, person-centred care.
kay-walls.why_medicine: Focuses on ADHD in adult women, a group she feels has historically been under-recognised and underserved.

quotes.text: For Kay, an ADHD assessment is never just a checklist.
She creates space for patients to tell their story fully, and many describe her consultations as the first time they have felt genuinely listened to.
With a background spanning mental health and women’s health, she has developed a particular focus on ADHD in adult women, a group she feels has historically been under-recognised and underserved.
Dr Kay Walls is a specialist general practitioner who brings warmth, curiosity, and a deeply holistic lens to everything she does.

natalie-cook.philosophy_of_care: Clear, evidence-based advice, tailored to each patient's circumstances, preferences and goals, including work, sleep and family.
natalie-cook.outside_medicine: Russian-born and trained; has practised in Central Queensland for over 11 years.

quotes.text: Her approach is direct, honest and safety-focused, providing clear, evidence-based advice while tailoring treatment to each patient’s individual circumstances, preferences and goals, including their work, sleep, family and day-to-day demands.
Dr Natalie Cook is a Russian-born and trained GP who has practised in Central Queensland for over 11 years.

rajitha-de-silva.philosophy_of_care: The best care begins with feeling heard; a safe, supportive, non-judgemental space for the most difficult issues.
rajitha-de-silva.communication_approach: A thoughtful, culturally sensitive approach shaped by practice in Sri Lanka and Australia.
rajitha-de-silva.outside_medicine: Has practised psychiatry in both Sri Lanka and Australia.

quotes.text: She believes that the best care begins with feeling heard.

Having practised in both Sri Lanka and Australia, she brings a thoughtful, culturally sensitive approach to helping people navigate life’s challenges.

shwetha-murthy.philosophy_of_care: Maps how symptoms have shown up over time and how they interact with mood, sleep and physical health.
shwetha-murthy.communication_approach: A calm, organised style with a strong focus on context (childhood, school reports, family roles, culture), explained in clear, practical language.
shwetha-murthy.outside_medicine: Trained in India, worked in the United Kingdom, in Australia since 2007.

quotes.text: In consultations, Shwetha brings a calm, organised style and a strong focus on context: childhood experiences, school reports, family roles, cultural background and current life demands.

She is especially interested in supporting women who are starting to wonder how their own history, their children’s experiences and ADHD might be connected, and in adult ADHD in men across blue-collar and white-collar work.

anu-saxena.philosophy_of_care: Culturally sensitive, holistic and patient-centred care.
anu-saxena.why_medicine: Came to medicine through psychology: a Bachelor of Psychology with First Class Honours at the University of Sydney, then her MD at the Australian National University.
anu-saxena.outside_medicine: Travelling, learning about different cultures, charity and community work, and staying active through sport.

allen-macbell.philosophy_of_care: Practical and individual, looking at how ADHD affects study, work, relationships and everyday life.

anubhav-saxena.philosophy_of_care: Works from measurement rather than impression: ADHD looked at alongside sleep, cardiovascular and metabolic health, with a documented baseline before anything starts.
anubhav-saxena.communication_approach: Review at set intervals rather than only when a problem gets loud enough to prompt a call.
anubhav-saxena.outside_medicine: Gives a good deal of his spare time to the Parramatta Eels.

My approach is warm, compassionate, person-centred and strengths-based, drawing on CBT, DBT, ACT, Compassion-Focused Therapy and Positive Psychology.
I have worked with depression, anxiety, trauma, neurodiversity (autism and ADHD), interpersonal difficulties, disordered eating and body image concerns.

The first session is about getting to know you, your story and what you would like to achieve, and she aims for you to leave each session with practical skills to take into everyday life.

yuri-lima.philosophy_of_care: With a lifelong passion for movement and sports, Yuri’s approach combines clinical expertise in orthopaedic and sports rehabilitation and patient-centred care to help clients return to their optimal level of function and performance.

quotes.text: With a lifelong passion for movement and sports, Yuri’s approach combines clinical expertise in orthopaedic and sports rehabilitation and patient-centred care to help clients return to their optimal level of function and performance.
